5000000.name: Brown Kitty
5000000.desc: They are quiet and gentle in nature, so they don't get hungry easily. They don't seem to be too obedient to their owners.
5000000.descD: This was once a cute little kitty, but it turned back into a doll when its Water of Life dried up. A little magic can bring it back to life...

5000001.name: Brown Puppy
5000001.desc: They are outgoing and active in nature, so they can't sit still for a period of time and get hungry often. They are very obedient to their owners.
5000001.descD: This was once a cute little puppy, but it turned back into a doll when its Water of Life dried up. A little magic can bring it back to life...

5000002.name: Pink Bunny
5000002.desc: They are well-behaved and quiet, so they eat the usual amount. They are smart and obedient, but also stubborn.
5000002.descD: This was once a cute little bunny, but it turned back into a doll when its Water of Life dried up. A little magic can bring it back to life...

5000003.name: Mini Kargo
5000003.desc: They are very, very active, so they get hungry pretty often. Very intelligent, they are quite obedient to their owners.
5000003.descD: This was once a cute little Mini Kargo, but it turned back into a doll when its Water of Life dried up. A little magic can bring it back to life...

5000004.name: Black Kitty
5000004.desc: They are quiet and gentle in nature, so they don't get hungry easily. They don't seem to be too obedient to their owners.
5000004.descD: This was once a cute little kitty, but it turned back into a doll when its Water of Life dried up. A little magic can bring it back to life...

5000005.name: White Bunny
5000005.desc: They are well-behaved and quiet, so they eat the usual amount. They are smart and obedient, but also stubborn.
5000005.descD: This was once a cute little bunny, but it turned back into a doll when its Water of Life dried up. A little magic can bring it back to life...

5000006.name: Husky
5000006.desc: Active, yet calm at times. Eats a moderate amount of food. Very smart overall.
5000006.descD: This was once a cute little Husky, but it turned back into a doll when its Water of Life dried up. A little magic can bring it back to life...

5000007.name: Black Pig
5000007.desc: Very active and hungry at all times. Needs to be fed often. Very friendly in nature, so it's easy to increase closeness with them.
5000007.descD: This was once a cute little black pig, but it turned back into a doll when its Water of Life dried up. A little magic can bring it back to life...

5000008.name: Panda
5000008.desc: Calm, relaxed, and gentle. A very rare creature.
5000008.descD: This was once a cute little panda, but it turned back into a doll when its Water of Life dried up. A little magic can bring it back to life...

5000009.name: Dino Boy
5000009.desc: A very adorable, male baby dinosaur that is both active and unpredictable.
5000009.descD: This was once a cute little Dino Boy, but it turned back into a doll when its Water of Life dried up. A little magic can bring it back to life...

5000010.name: Dino Girl
5000010.desc: A very adorable, female baby dinosaur that is both active and unpredictable.
5000010.descD: This was once a cute little Dino Girl, but it turned back into a doll when its Water of Life dried up. A little magic can bring it back to life...

5000011.name: Maple Snail
5000011.desc:
A rare-shaped snail that came along with MapleStory Fest 2026. The pet's skills will disappear once its magic runs out.
If you double-click the Maple Snail after its magic duration ends, it will disappear.

#cCaution! This pet cannot have its magic duration extended after it ends.#
5000011.descD: This was once a cute little Maple Snail, but it turned back into a doll when its magic ran out. Unfortunately, there's no way to revive this pet. Double-click on the doll to find out how to adopt a new pet.

5000054.name: Snail
5000054.desc: A snail that is really hard to figure out. The pet's skills will disappear once its magic runs out.
5000054.descD: This was once a cute little Snail, but it turned back into a doll when its magic ran out. Unfortunately, there's no way to revive this pet. Double-click on the doll to find out how to adopt a new pet.

5000012.name: Monkey
5000012.desc: Very charming and very intuitive, but not as obedient as some of the others.
5000012.descD: It was a cute little monkey, but with the "Water of Life" all dried up, it turned back into a doll. A little magic can bring it back to life...

5000013.name: White Tiger
5000013.desc: They are very gentle and obedient in nature, easily becoming friendly with their owner, which in turn speeds up the level-up process.
5000013.descD: It was a cute little white tiger, but with the "Water of Life" all dried up, it turned back into a doll. A little magic can bring it back to life...

5000014.name: Elephant
5000014.desc: Very outgoing and mature; doesn't need to be fed all the time. An intelligent pet that easily understands the commands from the master.
5000014.descD: It was a cute little Elephant, but with the "Water of Life" all dried up, it turned back into a doll. A little magic can bring it back to life...

5000015.name: Dasher
5000015.desc: They are smart and obedient by nature, picking up commands faster than other pets, but they also can get hungry in a hurry.
5000015.descD: It was a cute little Rudolph, but the "Water of Life" has completely dried up, turning it back into a doll. A little magic can bring it back to life...

5000016.name: Robot
5000016.desc: A hyper-active robot that always changes its mind on everything. Very unpredictable, yet easy to please.\n#cCaution! This pet cannot use pet equipment.#
5000016.descD: It was a cute little robot, but with the "Water of Life" all dried up, it turned back into a doll. A little magic can bring it back to life...\n#cCaution! This pet cannot use pet equipment.#

5000017.name: Mini Yeti
5000017.desc: A trustworthy pet that quietly watches everyone's back. Quiet, but smart and gets a lot of things done.
5000017.descD: It was a cute little Mini Yeti, but with the "Water of Life" all dried up, it turned back into a doll. A little magic can bring it back to life...

5000018.name: Turkey
5000018.desc: Somewhat active, quiet and not well-behaved in nature. It is not very obedient, but isn't hungry very often.
5000018.descD: It was a cute little Turkey, but the "Water of Life" has completely dried up, turning it back into a doll. A little magic can bring it back to life...

5000019.name: Penguin
5000019.desc: Penguins are always energetic and in good spirits.
5000019.descD: It was a cute little Penguin, but with the "Water of Life" all dried up, it turned back into a doll. A little magic can bring it back to life...

5000020.name: Black Bunny
5000020.desc: They are well-behaved and quiet, so they don't need to be fed more than the usual amount. They are smart and obedient, but also stubborn.
5000020.descD: It was a cute little bunny, but with the "Water of Life" all dried up, it turned back into a doll. A little magic can bring it back to life...

5000021.name: Husky
5000021.desc: Active, yet calm at times. Can be moderately fed. Very smart in general.
5000021.descD: It was a cute little Huskey, but with the "Water of Life" all dried up, it turned back into a doll. A little magic can bring it back to life...

5000022.name: Porcupine
5000022.desc: A small, furry creature with very, very sharp spikes. A lovable pet.
5000022.descD: It was a cute little porcupine, but with the "Water of Life" all dried up, it turned back into a doll. A little magic can bring it back to life...

5000023.name: Jr. Reaper
5000023.desc: This spooky little harvester of souls is happy to come along for the ride!
5000023.descD: Your spooky Jr. Reaper friend has turned into a doll. You can revive it with the Water of Life.

5000024.name: Snowman
5000024.desc: An adorable Snowman that is also very active. May seem a little rude at times, but the more it is loved, the more affable it becomes.
5000024.descD: It was a cute little snowman, but with the "Water of Life" all dried up, it turned back into a doll. A little magic can bring it back to life...

5000025.name: Orange Tiger
5000025.desc: They are very gentle and obedient in nature, easily becoming friendly with the owner, which in turn speeds up the level-up process.
5000025.descD: It was a cute little white tiger, but with the "Water of Life" all dried up, it turned back into a doll. A little magic can bring it back to life...

5000026.name: Skunk
5000026.desc: Calm and quiet by nature, the easy-going, eccentric Skunk has a rather humorous and pompous outlook on life, the finer things are what it enjoys.
5000026.descD: It was a cute little skunk, but with the "Water of Life" all dried up, it turned back into a doll. A little magic can bring it back to life...

5000027.name: Kino
5000027.desc: A happy-go-lucky, orange mushroom that loves shiny stones.
5000027.descD: Your lovely Orange Mushroom has turned into a doll. You can revive it with the Water of Life.

5000028.name: Gorilla Robo
5000028.desc: Mysterious magical powers aligned and sucessfully evolved the Baby Robo into the rare and majestic Gorilla Robo!
5000028.descD: It was a magnificent Gorilla Robo, but with the "Water of Life" all dried up, it turned back into a doll. A little magic can bring it back to life, however...

5000029.name: Crys.Rudolph
5000029.desc: The star of this year's Holidays. Projects an aura of nobility and gentleness. Only available during the winter Holidays!
5000029.descD: It was a magnificent Crystal Rudolph, but with the "Water of Life" all dried up, it turned back into a doll. A little magic can bring it back to life, however...

5000030.name: Toucan
5000030.desc: A trustworthy pet who is equally quick-witted. Unlike its masculine appearance, it is prone to insecurity and shyness.
5000030.descD: It was a cute Toucan, but with the "Water of Life" all dried up, it turned back into a doll. A little magic can bring it back to life, however...

5000031.name: White Duck
5000031.desc: Silly and foolish, but hard working and easy-going by nature, White Duck is easy to please, and enjoys good food and a swim.
5000031.descD: It was a magnificent White Duck, but with the "Water of Life" all dried up, it turned back into a doll. A little magic can bring it back to life, however...

5000032.name: Golden Pig
5000032.desc: It is a cute Golden Pig that brings luck to you.
5000032.descD: Your lucky Golden Pig has turned into a doll. You can revive it with the Water of Life.

5000033.name: Snail
5000033.desc:
A snail that is really hard to figure out. The pet's skills will disappear once its magic runs out.
If you double-click the Snail after its magic duration ends, it will disappear.

#cCaution! This pet cannot have its magic duration extended after it ends.#
5000033.descD: This was once a cute little Snail, but it turned back into a doll when its magic ran out. Unfortunately, there's no way to revive this pet. Double-click on the doll to find out how to adopt a new pet.
